description: Experimental Porous--Fisher conditioning study. It tests whether diagnostics flag hard states when a logistic reaction remains outside the diffusion preconditioner.
gmres_measurement_note: actual_gmres is the explicit residual-history count for P^-1 J delta=P^-1(-R), not NKStats.lin_iters.

physical_model.preconditioner_scope: diffusion-only D0 Helmholtz; reaction is unpreconditioned

reaction_effect.description: Identity-only geometry and actual GMRES work by reaction strength; the diffusion Helmholtz preconditioner does not include this reaction term.
reaction_effect.summary: yes: hard/easy identity separation survives every tested reaction strength, with indeterminate verdicts retained as non-adequate warnings.

regime_claim.description: Actual counted-GMRES iterations grouped by diagnostic verdict.

verdict_on_decision_procedure.summary: yes: identity disk rate rises from easy to hard systems and non-adequate verdicts do not fall.
